gloss: new school (after transfer); school one transfers to

definitions.gloss: new school after transfer; destination school
definitions.explanation: the school a student moves to when transferring from one school to another

examples.japanese: {転校先|てんこうさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧？
examples.english: Have you decided on your new school yet?

examples.japanese: {転校先|てんこうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm worried about whether I'll make friends at my new school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、{転校先|てんこうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to my father's job transfer we had to move, and it was a struggle finding a new school.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{転校|てんこう}→転校：03444_tenkou⟧ (school transfer) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination). The suffix ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ is commonly used to indicate where something is directed: ⟦{引越|ひっこ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (place one moves to), {就職先|しゅうしょくさき} (place of employment), ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧ (travel destination).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転校先|てんこうさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: the new school
- {転校先|てんこうさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: the new school is decided
- {転校先|てんこうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a new school
- {転校先|てんこうさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to the new school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転校|てんこう}→転校：03444_tenkou⟧: school transfer — the act of transferring itself
- {転入先|てんにゅうさき}: place of enrollment — more formal/administrative term for the receiving school
- ⟦{転校生|てんこうせい}→転校生：19652_tenkousei⟧: transfer student — the student who transfers
